finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the user inputs a line longer than MAX_LINE_LENGTH characters without hitting EOF or newline.
finding.assumptions: The function does not handle cases where the input exceeds MAX_LINE_LENGTH, leading to a buffer overflow.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If the input contains format specifiers or other escape sequences that are not intended to be part of the line content.
finding.assumptions: The input is directly printed without sanitization, which could lead to unintended behavior if the input contains format specifiers.
